g.text: Bounded Execution DAG & Blackboard Findings vs. Unbounded Agent Loops
Why enterprise cloud engineering requires deterministic information economics over chatty multi-agent loops.
Agents pass conversational summaries in cycles
Downstream agents spend 70% of tokens re-reading chat.
IR relevant cross-cloud runbooks saturate IDE vectors.
⚠️ High Hallucination Risk • Uncapped Cloud Spend
Deterministic Information Economics & Shared Blackboard Findings
Zero loop cycles • Strict finding schemas • Sub-linear token scaling
Shared facts store replaces 1000s of conversational tokens
Four Golden Signals & SLI/SLO burn risk
Automated gatekeeper posts structured SARIF/verdict as non-approving review comment.
🛡️ Policy: Formal approval reserved exclusively for Human Cloud Maintainer. Zero self-approvals.
Open Cloud Agents (v2.2.1) • Local-First Architecture • Aligned to AWS, Azure, & GCP Well-Architected Frameworks
